modern: The rottenness of the matter which is the foundation of everything! Water, dust, bones, filth: or again, marble rocks, the calluses of the earth; and gold and silver, the sediments; and clothes, only bits of hair; and purple dye, blood; and everything else is of the same kind. And that which is of the nature of breath is also another thing of the same kind, changing from this to that.

explained.summary: Look at what everything is made of and it’s rather unglamorous: water, dust, bones, muck. Marble is the earth’s hardened skin, gold and silver are its deposits, fine clothes are just hair, and the prized purple dye comes from shellfish blood. Even the breath of life is just another substance, always shifting. Marcus is stripping the lustre off things people prize.
explained.today: Strip a designer label, a new car or the latest phone down to plastic, metal and fabric, and the hold it has on you loosens a little. Marcus’s purple dye is today’s luxury logo.
